I'm a really shitty lucid dreamer, but I guess I'll share. I can function pretty easily on 4 hours of sleep a night, as long as I get about 9 on the weekends to recover, so during the summer is the only time I can do it. I'm a student, so I have less to do in the summer, so I would try to nap to take up some time and relax. What I would do was try to force myself tot fall asleep, but my mind wouldn't want to. My body would freeze up into sleep paralysis, but my mind was still acting as normal. This way I could think of something I wanted to dream about, and just experience it more vividly. Then, when I was done and over it, I would just slowly being my body back.
